info.name: Agro Connect Backend API
info.description:
# Agro Connect Server API Collection
Complete Postman collection covering all backend endpoints for the Agro Connect marketplace platform.

### Base Variables:
- `baseUrl`: `http://localhost:4092/api/v1`
- `serverUrl`: `http://localhost:4092`
- `accessToken`: JWT Bearer Token (automatically set on Login)

### Authentication:
All endpoints are protected with Bearer JWT by default unless explicitly decorated with `@IsPublic()`.

item.name: 00. System
item.description: Server root health check and status endpoints.

request.description:
### Server Health Check
Checks whether the Argo Connect backend server is active and running.

- **Authentication:** Public (None)
- **Endpoint:** `GET /`

item.name: 01. Auth
item.description: User registration, OTP verification, authentication, password management, and role profile setups.

request.description:
### Register User
Registers a new user (BUYER, DRIVER, or PRODUCER) and dispatches a 6-digit OTP code to the provided email.

- **Authentication:** Public
- **Role Supported:** `BUYER`, `DRIVER`, `PRODUCER`

### Request Body Fields:
- `fullName`: Full name of user (Required)
- `email`: Valid email address (Required)
- `password`: Strong password string (Required)
- `role`: One of `BUYER`, `DRIVER`, `PRODUCER` (Required)

response.name: 200 OK - Verification Code Sent

request.description:
### Verify Registration
Verifies the 6-digit OTP sent to the user's email during registration, creating the verified user account.

- **Authentication:** Public

### Request Body Fields:
- `email`: Registered email address (Required)
- `otp`: 6-digit verification OTP (Required)
- `fcmToken`: Firebase Cloud Messaging device push token // optional

response.name: 200 OK - Verified Successfully (Buyer)
200 OK - Verified Successfully (Producer)

exec: console.log('Access token updated from verify registration');

request.description:
### Login User
Authenticates user credentials and returns a signed JWT access token. Automatically stores `accessToken` into collection variables.

- **Authentication:** Public

### Request Body Fields:
- `email`: Registered email (Required)
- `password`: Account password (Required)
- `fcmToken`: Firebase device token for push notifications // optional

exec: console.log('Access token successfully set to collection variable: accessToken');

request.description:
### Forgot Password OTP
Sends a 6-digit password reset OTP to the specified user email address.

- **Authentication:** Public

### Request Body Fields:
- `email`: User registered email address (Required)

### Verify Password Reset OTP
Validates the OTP received by email for resetting forgotten password. Returns an authorized temporary access token to reset password.

- **Authentication:** Public

### Request Body Fields:
- `email`: User registered email (Required)
- `otp`: 6-digit OTP code (Required)

exec: console.log('Temporary reset token saved to accessToken variable');

request.description:
### Reset Password
Sets a new password for the account using the bearer token obtained from verifying forgot password OTP.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Authenticated)

### Request Body Fields:
- `password`: New password string (Required)

### Change Password
Allows an authenticated user to change their current password by providing the old password and the new password.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Authenticated)

### Request Body Fields:
- `oldPassword`: Current password (Required)
- `newPassword`: New replacement password (Required)

### Refresh Access Token
Issues a fresh access token using a valid JWT refresh token.

- **Authentication:** Public

### Request Body Fields:
- `refreshToken`: Valid JWT refresh token string (Required)

request.description:
### Create Producer Profile (Multipart)
Uploads required legal and verification documents and registers the producer profile.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `PRODUCER`)
- **Body Mode:** `form-data`

### File Fields:
- `nidUrl`: National Identity card file (Required for all producers)
- `landCertificate`: Land ownership certificate file (Required for `Private` producerType) // optional for Company
- `farmPhotoUrl`: Photograph of the farm/field (Required for `Private` producerType) // optional for Company
- `companyCertificate`: Company registration certificate file (Required for `Company` producerType) // optional for Private
- `rcmUrl`: RCM certificate document file (Required for `Company` producerType) // optional for Private
- `taxUrl`: Tax declaration document file (Required for `Company` producerType) // optional for Private

### Text Fields:
- `phoneNumber`: Phone number with country code (Required)
- `producerType`: `Private` or `Company` (Required)
- `city`: City location (Required)
- `region`: Province or administrative region (Required)
- `address`: Detailed physical address (Required)
- `farmName`: Name of the farm or agricultural enterprise (Required)
- `farmSize`: Size of farm in hectares (Required)
- `farmLocation`: GPS/geographic location description (Required)
- `companyName`: Registered corporate name // optional (Required if Company)
- `rccmNo`: RCCM business registry number // optional (Required if Company)
- `sirenNo`: SIREN registry number // optional (Required if Company)

- `companyCertificate`: Replacement company cert // optional
- `rcmUrl`: Replacement RCM file // optional
- `taxUrl`: Replacement tax cert file // optional
- `farmName`: Updated farm name // optional
- `farmSize`: Updated farm size in hectares // optional
- `farmLocation`: Updated location details // optional
- `companyName`: Updated company name // optional
- `rccmNo`: Updated RCCM number // optional
- `sirenNo`: Updated SIREN number // optional

request.description:
### Create Driver Profile (Multipart)
Uploads required vehicle photo, identity, and licensing documents and creates driver profile.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `DRIVER`)
- **Body Mode:** `form-data`

### File Fields (All Required):
- `vehiclePhotoUrl`: Official photo of the driver's vehicle (Required)
- `nidUrl`: National Identity card document (Required)
- `drivingLicenseUrl`: Valid driver's license document (Required)
- `vehicleRegistrationUrl`: Official vehicle registration document (Required)
- `insuranceUrl`: Active insurance policy certificate (Required)
- `policeClearanceUrl`: Police record clearance document (Required)

### Text Fields:
- `phoneNumber`: Valid phone number (Required)
- `city`: Operating city (Required)
- `region`: Operating region (Required)
- `address`: Home or depot address (Required)
- `vehicleType`: Enum: `BIKE`, `MOTORCYCLE`, `THREE_WHEELER`, `VAN`, `TRUCK`, `PICKUP` (Required)
- `registrationNumber`: Official license plate number (Required)
- `model`: Vehicle make and model (Required)
- `year`: Manufacturing year between 1900 and 2026 (Required)
- `vehicleColor`: Exterior color of vehicle (Required)

formdata.description: One of: BIKE, MOTORCYCLE, THREE_WHEELER, VAN, TRUCK, PICKUP (Required)

item.name: 02. Admin
item.description: Administrator operations including producer and driver approvals, catalog category management, driver assignments, coupons, and terms.

request.description:
### List All Producers
Returns paginated list of producers with search, verification status filter, producer type filter, and summary counts.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)

### Query Parameters:
- `search`: Search query string on email and fullName // optional
- `verificationStatus`: Filter by `Pending`, `Accepted`, `Rejected` // optional
- `producerType`: Filter by `Private` or `Company` // optional
- `order`: Sort direction `asc` or `desc` // optional
- `page`: Page number (Default: 1) // optional
- `limit`: Items per page (Default: 10) // optional

response.name: 200 OK - Producers Found

request.description:
### Review Producer Account Verification
Approves or rejects a pending producer application. When rejected, a reason must be supplied.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)

### Request Body Fields:
- `accountId`: User ID of the producer (Required)
- `isAccept`: `true` to approve, `false` to reject (Required)
- `rejectReason`: Rejection explanation message // optional (Required if isAccept is false)

### List All Drivers
Returns paginated drivers list with vehicle filters, verification status filters, and active driver counts.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)

### Query Parameters:
- `search`: Search driver name or email // optional
- `verificationStatus`: `Pending`, `Accepted`, `Rejected` // optional
- `vehicleType`: Enum: `BIKE`, `MOTORCYCLE`, `THREE_WHEELER`, `VAN`, `TRUCK`, `PICKUP` // optional
- `order`: `asc` or `desc` // optional
- `page`: Page number // optional
- `limit`: Items per page // optional

response.name: 200 OK - Drivers Found

request.description:
### List All Buyers
Fetches paginated list of all registered buyers and overall suspended account counts.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)

### Query Parameters:
- `search`: Search buyer name or email // optional
- `order`: `asc` or `desc` // optional
- `page`: Page index // optional
- `limit`: Page size // optional

response.name: 200 OK - Buyers Found

request.description:

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)

### Request Body Fields:
- `accountId`: User ID of driver (Required)
- `isAccept`: `true` to approve, `false` to reject (Required)
- `rejectReason`: Rejection explanation string // optional (Required if isAccept is false)

request.description:
### List All Categories
Fetches all active and inactive product categories for the marketplace catalog.

- **Authentication:** Public

response.name: 200 OK - Categories List

request.description:
### Toggle Category Active Status
Flips the active visibility status of a category.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)
- **URL Param:** `id` - Category MongoId (Required)

### Assign Driver to Order Delivery
Assigns an available, verified driver to an active paid order.

- **Authentication:** Public

### Request Body Fields:
- `orderId`: MongoId of active order (Required)
- `driverId`: MongoId of verified driver user (Required)

### Create Promotional Coupon
Creates a discount percentage coupon code with expiration date.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)

### Request Body Fields:
- `code`: Unique alphanumeric coupon code (Required)
- `discount`: Percentage discount from 1 to 99 (Required)
- `expiryDate`: ISO Date string expiration (Required)

### Update Platform Terms
Updates or initializes platform terms and legal conditions text/HTML.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)

### Request Body Fields:
- `content`: Terms content markdown or HTML (Required)

### List All Orders (Admin)
Fetches paginated list of paid orders across the platform with customer details, order metrics, item counts, and revenue statistics.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)

### Query Parameters:
- `search`: Search orderId, customer fullName, or customer email // optional
- `status`: Filter by status: `Active`, `Delivered`, `Cancelled` // optional
- `page`: Page index (default: 1) // optional
- `limit`: Page size (default: 10) // optional

### View Order Details (Admin)
Retrieves comprehensive information for a specific order including customer profile, shipping address, ordered products with farm origin, and assigned delivery logistics.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `ADMIN`)
- **URL Param:** `id` - Order MongoId (Required)

response.name: 200 OK - Order Details Retrieved

### Create Product (Multipart)
Creates a new agricultural product listing under the verified producer's catalog.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `PRODUCER`)
- **Body Mode:** `form-data`

### File Fields:
- `imageUrls`: Multiple product photos (At least 1 file required)

### Text Fields:
- `name`: Product name (Required)
- `description`: Detailed description of harvest, quality, origin (Required)
- `categoryId`: MongoId of category (Required)
- `sellingUnit`: Enum: `KG`, `GRAM`, `PIECE`, `DOZEN`, `LITER`, `BAG`, `BUNDLE`, `CRATE` (Required)
- `pricePerUnit`: Price per unit in integer currency units (Required)
- `availableQuantity`: Available stock quantity in integer units (Required)
- `isFeatured`: Feature on homepage // optional
- `isActive`: Product listing active visibility // optional

item.name: 04. Shopping
item.description: Shopping cart items, quantity adjustments, and wishlist management.

request.description:
### Add Item to Shopping Cart
Adds a designated quantity of a product to the buyer's active cart.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)

### Request Body Fields:
- `productId`: Product MongoId (Required)
- `quantity`: Quantity integer >= 1 (Required)

### View Cart
Fetches all product items currently in the authenticated buyer's cart.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)

response.name: 200 OK - Cart Items Found

request.description:
### Update Cart Quantity
Increments or decrements the quantity of a specific cart item.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)

### Request Body Fields:
- `cartId`: MongoId of cart record (Required)
- `increment`: `true` to add 1, `false` to subtract 1 (Required)

### Remove Item from Cart
Deletes a specific cart line item by its Cart record ID.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)
- **URL Param:** `id` - Cart record MongoId (Required)

### Toggle Product Wishlist
Adds product to wishlist if not already saved, or removes it if already present.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)
- **URL Param:** `id` - Product MongoId (Required)

### View Wishlist
Fetches all product items currently saved to the buyer's wishlist.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)

response.name: 200 OK - Wishlist Items Found

item.name: 05. Order
item.description: Order checkout, CinetPay payment verification, delivery OTP workflows, and discount coupon applications.

request.description:
### Create Order & Initialize Payment
Converts cart items into an active order and generates the checkout session URL.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)

### Request Body Fields:
- `shippingAddressId`: MongoId of chosen shipping address (Required)
- `cartIds`: Array of Cart MongoIds to purchase (Required)
- `couponCode`: Promotional coupon code // optional

### Initiate CinetPay Checkout
Generates a fresh CinetPay payment session URL for an existing pending order.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)
- **URL Param:** `orderId` - Order reference identifier (Required)

### Verify Payment Status
Queries payment status against CinetPay and updates order status accordingly.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)
- **URL Param:** `transactionId` - CinetPay transaction ID or Order ID (Required)

### Buyer Order History
Fetches paginated list of orders placed by the authenticated buyer.

- **Authentication:** Bearer Token (Role: `BUYER`)

### Query Parameters:
- `search`: Search order identifier // optional
- `status`: Filter by OrderStatus: `Pending`, `Active`, `PartiallyCancelled`, `Shipped`, `Delivered`, `Cancelled`, `Refunded` // optional
- `paymentStatus`: Filter by PaymentStatus: `Pending`, `Paid`, `Failed`, `PartiallyRefunded`, `Refunded` // optional
